all_of_review.review: The fixed R161 protocol can require a joint eight-component vector while the three inspected source routes contain only separate components. The Sigma_rho family witnesses non-identification without asserting universal data absence.

A fixed R161 decision, disjoint nuisance-only pilot and planwise-valid confirmatory intervals can coexist. The explicit third premise repairs the initial invalid shortcut from independence to calibration.

concept_quantifier_scope_review.source_audit: Exactly three named public routes; no exhaustive absence claim.
concept_quantifier_scope_review.covariance: One joint participant-level eight-contrast vector; separate marginal samples are not paired observations.
concept_quantifier_scope_review.pilot: Prospective disjoint participants under the exact protocol; no pilot, ethics approval or recruitment occurred.
concept_quantifier_scope_review.coverage: Every pilot record and every selected plan in its range; the simple discharge is Gaussian complete-vector only.
concept_quantifier_scope_review.decision: One frozen simultaneous interval family, fixed contrast order and all six inherited gates.
concept_quantifier_scope_review.phenomenal_target: C1 remains tokenwise; B_min and F_O are not identified by population covariance or decisions.

joint_consistency.note: Finite checks verify bounded algebra and implementation only; they do not validate Gaussianity, missingness, human effects or global semantics.

object_time_signature_actuality_review.detail: Pilot and confirmatory participants, marginal source samples, trial tokens, population parameters and one actual C1 organization remain distinct. No common h or cross-token phenomenal bearer is inferred.

evidence_level_review.public_source_scope: primary methods/data-availability audit without raw-file reanalysis
evidence_level_review.mathematics: manual proof plus exact finite witnesses
evidence_level_review.coverage: conditional theorem with an explicit statistical premise

purpose_review: R162 advances the actual-organization program by specifying what joint uncertainty object the concrete body/tool proposal needs, proving why component datasets cannot supply it, and defining a nonleaking prospective route. It does not turn measurement convenience into a consciousness criterion.
